description: This file is the entry point for a front-end application that initializes a LightningJS application and configures key mappings for user interaction.

methods.name: Blits.Launch
methods.description: Initializes and launches the LightningJS application with specified configurations and key mappings.

calls: Blits.Launch(App, 'app', { w: 1280, h: 720, keys: { up: ['ArrowUp'], down: ['ArrowDown'], left: ['ArrowLeft'], right: ['ArrowRight'], enter: ['Enter'], back: ['Escape'] } })
